typography.guidelines: Playfair Display EXCLUSIVELY for Display/H1/H2 headings. Inter for everything else. Use wide tracking on small uppercase labels. Kinetic editorial typography with massive whitespace.

colors.guidelines: Strict adherence to brand palette. NO GRADIENTS. NO GLASSMORPHISM. NO BLUR GLOW. Light backgrounds only. Gold ONLY in tiny decorative accents (thin dividers, small icons, price tags). Maroon dominant for actions.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4DED3. Thin gold top hairline (#B08D57) on service cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: 4px to 8px only. NO pill/bubble buttons. NO fully rounded corners.
visual_enhancers.shadows: NO shadow-pop. Flat aesthetic. Use thin hairline borders and slight background tone shifts (#FAF7F2 vs #F1ECE3) to create depth instead of drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.imagery_treatment: Spotlight/clipped frames. Real product photography treated deliberately (e.g., tight crops, framed by white space). NO generic stock car photos. Vehicle categories MUST use minimal icons/line art.

grids_layouts.general: High editorial whitespace (use tailwind p-12 to p-32). Asymmetric bento grids mixed with wide single-column text blocks.
grids_layouts.chapters: Numbered manifesto layout (e.g., '01 — The Coast', '02 — The Car', '03 — The Driver', '04 — The Journey'). Bold editorial layout with slow scroll reveals.
grids_layouts.service_cards: Three-card overview (Cars with Driver, Self-Drive, Group Travel). Flat cards, ivory fill (#F1ECE3), thin gold top hairline.
grids_layouts.pricing_tables: Editorial monospace-adjacent treatment. Horizontally scrollable on mobile. Semantic th/td with pale stone (#E4DED3) hairline borders.

motion.reveal: Framer-motion scroll-reveal. Opacity and Y-axis transforms ONLY (e.g., initial { opacity: 0, y: 30 } animate { opacity: 1, y: 0 }). NO scale-bounce, NO tilt, NO exaggerated hover.
motion.hero_sequence: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal of oversized editorial headline (Playfair) + kinetic supporting metadata + subtle parallax/3D moment (e.g., slow-drifting coastline still inside a spotlight-clipped frame).
motion.marquee: One slow horizontal marquee (single-line editorial ticker) for destinations or vehicle categories.

components_instructions.Header: Global nav. Text wordmark left ('GOA YATRA / TTG TRAVELS' in brand maroon serif style). 5 text links + Call + WhatsApp right. Active link = thin maroon underline. Off-white solid background on scroll (NO blur/glassmorphism).
components_instructions.Footer: Bordeaux (#490F0D) background. Off-white text. Trust strip, address, phone, email, hours, Instagram link, copyright.
components_instructions.Mobile_Sticky_Bar: Sticky bottom dual-action bar. Call = maroon fill, WhatsApp = whatsapp green fill. Visible only on mobile viewports.
components_instructions.Buttons: Corner radii 4-8px. Solid fills. Maroon dominant. No exaggerated hover effects—just subtle opacity or background color shifts.
components_instructions.Contact_About: Mini-bio for owner Yuvraj Banothkar. FAQ accordion. Embedded Google Map iframe (keyless embed). Final CTA band.

accessibility_and_testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="call-button"`, `data-testid="whatsapp-button"`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. Do NOT center align text globally. 2. Create depth through hairline borders and background tone shifts, NOT shadows. 3. Use 2-3x more spacing than comfortable (e.g., p-12 to p-32). 4. Micro-animations must be subtle (y-axis and opacity only). 5. Do not use AI emojis. 6. Prioritize text-heavy editorial aesthetic with cropped image frames. 7. NO generic car stock photos—use icons/line art for vehicles. 8. Ensure strictly 'flat' UI elements adhering exactly to the color palette.
